description: List the individual model calls behind get_llm_usage, newest first: what each was for, its provider and model, tokens and cost. Filter by operation and by start_date and end_date, and page with limit and offset. Read-only. Needs a Last Price credential. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

end_date.description: The end of the period, as an ISO 8601 date and time.

limit.description: How many to return. Defaults to 50.

offset.description: How many to skip, for the next page.

operation.description: Only calls made for this operation.

start_date.description: The start of the period, as an ISO 8601 date and time.

name: list_llm_usage_events
